1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said composition is formulated for oil and gas field applications__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, and zirconium acetylacetonate__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __having a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __wherein said composition is stable in field brine__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein said crosslinker provides delayed release properties__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein said composition maintains stability in seawater__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __wherein said nanoparticle provides controlled release of encapsulated materials__.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __for oil and gas field applications__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said composition is formulated for oil and gas field applications__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __for controlled release applications__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, __wherein said multivalent cation provides crosslinking functionality__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a) __wherein said polymer is selected from polyacrylamide-co-acrylic acid polymers having anionic sites__; and c) a fluid __selected from field brine or seawater__.

22) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __having anionic sites for crosslinking with multivalent cations__.

23) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a degree of hydrolysis suitable for oil field applications__.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein said polymer has anionic sites for crosslinking__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater __for oil and gas field applications__.
